summary.ko: TUM 학생의 숙박시설 교육용 설계입니다. 실제 준공 건물이 아닙니다. 외피 분류와 에너지 입력은 확인되지 않아 에너지 등급을 산정하지 않습니다.
summary.en: A fictional hospitality design by TUM students. Exterior-envelope classification and energy inputs are unresolved; no energy rating is calculated.

areas.floorAreaNote: 26 spaces with no area quantity use measured plan unions of their solid or FootPrint geometry; quantities retain priority where present. See spaces.json floorAreaSource per row.
areas.openingsNote: Glazing aperture 130.33 m² = 0 IfcWindow at OverallWidth × OverallHeight (0 m²) + 23 exterior IfcCurtainWall at the projected outline of their plates and mullions (130.33 m²; the glass plates alone give 123.11 m², the bounding rectangles 130.4 m²). Exterior doors are separate — a door is aperture, not glazing: 0 IfcDoor, 0 m², OverallWidth × OverallHeight. Host wall by IfcRelFillsElement → IfcOpeningElement → IfcRelVoidsElement (0 openings); a curtain wall is its own wall segment (23). Sector is the host wall's, from the same orientation pass as the wall split. Envelope by a both-sides probe against the conditioned IfcSpace solids (26 of 26 have geometry): 0 curtain wall(s) with a room on both sides excluded as interior screens (0 m²); 98 openings hosted in walls outside the exterior set; nothing unresolved. IsExternal is reported per row and never used as a filter — it means "not an interior partition" to an authoring tool, never "bounds conditioned space against outdoor air". It marks 14 door(s) here; 0 confirm against an exterior wall, 14 do not: #2596 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2400mm:1597571 2.5 m², #3051 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2400mm:1597715 2.5 m², #3066 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2400mm:1597766 2.5 m², #3081 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2400mm:1597954 2.5 m², #3096 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2400mm:1598042 2.5 m², #3111 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2400mm:1598146 2.5 m², #3126 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2400mm:1598276 2.5 m², #3141 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2400mm:1598334 2.5 m², #48225 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2200mm:1712416 2.3 m², #48679 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2200mm:1712530 2.3 m², #50473 M_Door-Passage-Single-Vision_Lite:750 x 2000mm:1712675 1.79 m², #50528 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2200mm:1715003 2.3 m², #50543 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2200mm:1715105 2.3 m², #50558 M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush:900 x 2200mm:1715293 2.3 m². areas.volumeNote: Gross from 26 spaces (floor area × storey height; voids, and rooms taller than their storey with no void above, as their own solids); net from 26 spaces (26 from own solid). A closed tessellation's signed volume is exact.
areas.roofNote: Plan shadow per element (union of its projected triangles, ifc-plan-shadow.mjs): 0 elements — . roofProjectedSqm sums 0 roof type(s), each as the union of its elements; the elements themselves sum to 0 m² (elements of one type overlapping in plan) and all types together cover 0 m² (one type above another). surfaceSqm is each element's true one-sheet surface (Σ area of its upward faces; ÷ 2 where a surface model has no downward face and both sheets are wound upward; ÷ the coverage where its parts cover its shadow more than once, as stacked layer solids do — surfaceBasis says which), summing to 0 m²; a flat deck's surface equals its shadow, a pitched roof's exceeds it. Source slab geometry is displayed. An absence of ROOF-typed entities is not evidence of no roof; roof classification remains unresolved.
areas.groundNote: IfcSlab (not ROOF or LANDING) on storeys at or below GROUND FLOOR (0 m): 45 candidate(s). A slab counts as ground envelope when a conditioned space stands on it — its shadow overlaps a conditioned ground-storey space footprint (14 of 14 such spaces have one: 14 solid) or an IfcRelSpaceBoundary names it as bounding one. IsExternal is not consulted. 1 counted, 44 excluded: "Floor:conc 200 mm:1661007" 1472.6 m², "Floor:grass 1m:1662345" 217.85 m², "Floor:grass 1m:1662345:2" 251.5 m², "Floor:grass 1m:1662345:3" 200 m², "Floor:grass 1m:1662345:4" 135 m², "Floor:grass 1m:1662345:5" 3468.76 m², "Floor:grass 1m:1662345:6" 1913.39 m², "Floor:tile 1m 2:1664020" 59.59 m², "Floor:tile 1m 2:1664169" 59.59 m², "Floor:10cm asphalt:1665053" 578.64 m², "Floor:10cm asphalt 2:1665139" 721.04 m², "Floor:Road center line:1665883" 1.2 m², "Floor:concrete floor 80cm:1666406" 590.36 m², "Floor:concrete floor 1m 2:1666590" 194.85 m², "Floor:side walk inner:1668712" 111.51 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671690" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671837" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671846" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671855" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671864" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671873" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671882" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671891" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671900" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671909" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671918" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671927" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671936" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671945" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671954" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671963" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671972" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671981" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671990" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1671999" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672008" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672017" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672026" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672035" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672044" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672053" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672062" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672071" 1.2 m², "Floor:Road center line:1672080" 1.2 m². groundSlabSqm is the union of the counted shadows (they sum to 233.82 m²; stacked build-up layers count once); groundPerimeterM is the outline's outer ring.

orientation.note: Azimuths are clockwise from north, where north is the model's -Z after web-ifc's Z-up to Y-up conversion. Outward face inferred by comparing each face's centroid with the building centre, which is correct for a convex plan and can be wrong at a re-entrant corner.

architecturalDetails.triangleCountBasis: triangleCount stores each instanced shape once; placedTriangleCount includes every placement
architecturalDetails.appearance: web-ifc tessellator RGBA, including possible default styles; no inferred finish textures. Metalness 0 and roughness 0.85 are renderer assumptions, not measured material properties.
architecturalDetails.note: Selected source IFC entity classes omitted from the core fabric layer. Original tessellated geometry and placements; repeated shapes use GPU instancing. Not a claim of complete architectural or fabrication detail. Existing services remain separate.

summary.ko: 원본 IFC에 설비 요소가 있지만 검증된 MEP 형상 레이어는 아직 공개되지 않았습니다.
summary.en: The source IFC states services occurrences, but a verified MEP geometry layer has not been published.

limitations.ko: 해시로 고정된 IFC 파일에서 해당 스키마의 설비 분류 상속을 확인한 요소 목록이며, 실제 설치 설비의 완전성 조사가 아닙니다.
limitations.en: Inventory of distribution occurrence classes using each pinned IFC file's schema inheritance, not a completeness survey of installed services.

limitations.ko: 분야별·수정본 모델 간 요소가 중복될 수 있으며 파일 간 설비 중복 제거는 하지 않았습니다.
limitations.en: Counts include overlapping discipline and revision models; there is no cross-file equipment deduplication.

limitations.ko: 일반 IfcBuildingElementProxy·IfcFurnishingElement는 원본 근거 없이 MEP로 분류하지 않습니다.
limitations.en: Generic IfcBuildingElementProxy and IfcFurnishingElement occurrences are not classified as MEP without source evidence.

model.note: Source fabric tessellation; furniture and railings are separate details. web-ifc reports a failed triangulation for source IfcPolygonalFaceSet #50442. Rendered geometry may omit affected surfaces; completeness is not established. No energy baseline is calculated.

invalidDiagnostics.note: No space-boundary strips resolved in this file; there is no sum to refute.

galleryEvidence.spacesHashScope: UTF-8 JSON.stringify of parsed spaces.json; independent of checkout line endings

materialFabric.appearanceBasis: IFC occurrence or type material association. For a layer set, the thickest stated layer is used as an illustrative representative, not as the verified exterior finish. Source layer order does not establish installation direction. Unreviewed material names remain neutral. Glazing retains its base role appearance.
